_note: Sound effects from the HyperFrames media-use skill (Pixabay Content License, see CREDITS.md). peak = seconds from file start to the loudest 50 ms, used to land the peak where a transition begins. gainDb brings every file to about -27 dBFS at its peak, roughly 9 dB under the narration (median -18 dBFS), measured 2026-09-28. whoosh.mp3 was dropped: byte-identical to whoosh-short.mp3.

whoosh-short.use: a photo sliding or wiping into the next

sparkle.use: a poster or infographic opening up

ping.use: a chart or a key figure arriving

click-soft.use: a quiet tick, list or UI
